label: Foreign-born living in Lebanon, by origin, 2024 (all census-based years)
source: UN DESA Population Division, International Migrant Stock 2024 (Table 1, destination and origin)
notes: UN DESA reports only 9 origin countries for Lebanon plus 'Others' (32,149 in 2024, not mapped) and regional totals. Total foreign-born in Lebanon 2024 = 681,720. Syria 2015 onwards is largely UNHCR-registered refugees; Palestine is mainly UNRWA-registered refugees.
